paragraphs.label: Ứng tuyển
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to apply for the volunteer helper role at a flexible working discussion. I saw your notice at the community centre and would welcome the opportunity to support a useful local activity.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu vị trí và nguồn thông tin.

paragraphs.label: Động lực
paragraphs.text: I am interested in flexible working hours because employees can organise work around practical personal needs. I would enjoy helping participants compare working schedules and plan shared team hours. I also understand that team members may not be available at the same time, so clear instructions and patient support are important.

paragraphs.label: Kinh nghiệm
paragraphs.text: I have helped organise small activities at my college, including welcoming participants and preparing materials. This taught me to explain simple instructions, keep a list of tasks and ask for help when necessary. I can check that participants have a sample weekly schedule and help them find the right place before the session begins.
paragraphs.noteVi: Kinh nghiệm mẫu phù hợp vai trò, không tự nhận chuyên gia.

paragraphs.label: Thời gian và kết
paragraphs.text:
I am available on Saturday at nine in the morning, and I can arrive earlier to help with preparation. I would be happy to attend a short interview or training session if required.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter. Please let me know if you need any further information. I look forward to your reply.

Yours sincerely,
Minh Nguyen
